items.title: Higher-regulator and Deligne structures on Picard modular surfaces related by a noncritical GU(2,1) L-value
items.author: Linli Shi
items.difficulty_reason: The complete higher-regulator formula combines motivic coefficient classes and boundary vanishing/interior motives with explicit automorphic differential forms, Hodge/Betti pairings, global and local zeta integrals, archimedean Whittaker computation and rational period comparisons. Both parity formulas and all original weight/nonvanishing/genericity setup are retained in one theorem. The old archimedean zeta proposition is only a local support calculation, not this regulator-versus-Deligne structure formula. Motivic-L translations and nontriviality applications retained without further counts.

primary.label: Complete original two-parity higher-regulator/Deligne-structure L-value theorem

proof_spans.label: Complete original algebraic/automorphic setup, motivic classes and boundary vanishing, differential forms, pairings, zeta integrals, periods and L-function support proofs
Complete original proof of both parity formulas
